blind.description: A vertical wooden post anchored in a square stone plinth. The timber is dark and weathered with chamfered upper edges. Two iron ring shackles hang from metal fittings near the top, and a pair of hinged iron wrist cuffs/manacles are bolted to one face at roughly chest height. Surfaces and geometry are solid, well-defined, and fully manifold with no floating pieces or melting.
blind.from_above: A square wooden post top with beveled edges and wood grain texture, with the slightly wider square stone plinth visible beneath it, two circular iron loops projecting on opposite sides, and a pair of cuffs projecting from the front face.
blind.height_vs_figure: About the same height as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5 ft 9 in to 6 ft tall), and the base is about one-third the width of the figure's shoulder diameter.
